scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --d1=runner-os-core-production --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist/ && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/_worker.js && printf '{"version":1,"include":["/*"],"exclude":["/_headers","/static/*"]}' > dist/_routes.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
